def check_s_palindrome(s):
    left = 0
    right = len(s) - 1
    while left < right:
        if s[left] != s[right]:
            return "NIE"
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return "TAK"

    mid = n // 2

        return "TAK" if s[:mid] == s[mid+1:][::-1] else "NIE"
